messages:
Sam H.: quick check — can we lock the staging reservation for Dedicated for next-week canary? need to tell product whether to expect 3 nodes or 6.
Priyanka R.: aiming for 6 but one full rack is still in burn-in. ETA firmware + burn-in is end of day sunday. leaning yes but not final.
Oli (eng-infra): rack power cage cleared but PSU parity test has one failing unit, replacement is on a truck arriving tomorrow AM. that could slip the burn-in by ~12-24h.
Sam H.: ok noted. @Priyanka can you confirm whether 3 nodes would be minimally useful for the canary if the other 3 slip? Product wants a hard yes/no by EOD.
Priyanka R.: yes — 3 nodes ok for latency and basic traffic patterns, but we won’t hit full throughput (batching tests will be limited). can run smoke with shadow traffic.
Zhen: also need network ACLs in place for VPC peering test. I checked and a few subnets are missing the dedicated route. I can add them but need someone from infra to approve the change.
Oli (eng-infra): I can approve. @Zhen paste the exact CIDR you'll add and I'll push. recommend adding 10.42.8.0/24 and 10.42.9.0/24.
Zhen: thanks — here's the small ips change I plan to apply (one-liner):
```
aws ec2 create-route --route-table-id rtb-0abc123 --destination-cidr-block 10.42.8.0/24 --vpc-peering-connection-id pcx-0ff
```
apply to two route tables and one shared-fw rule.
Sam H.: also a heads-up: the deployment job needs the new model bundle tagged `dedicated-v2` — @deploy-bot can you confirm the pipeline will pick that up if we push the tag today?
deploy-bot: CI pipeline will pick tags matching `dedicated-*` from the release registry. last successful pick was 1732090000. you should be safe to tag, but ensure artifact checksum matches (SHA256).
Priyanka R.: action items: 1) Oli to approve and watch PSU replacement (inflight) 2) Zhen to apply route additions 3) Sam to tag `dedicated-v2` artifact and notify deploy pipeline 4) Priyanka to confirm 3-node fallback messaging to product by EOD.
Oli (eng-infra): doing the approval now and will post when PSU is racked.
Zhen: will apply both routes in ~20m and ping here with the route-table ids.
Sam H.: thanks all. if anything slips beyond Monday morning we’ll fallback to a limited-canary plan (3 nodes, no heavy batching). ping me for any blocker. :thumbsup:
Priyanka R.: noted. will post final confirmation in this thread before 18:00 PT.
Oli (eng-infra): PSU racked and parity test passing — burn-in continuing.
Zhen: routes applied: rtb-0abc123, rtb-0def456. fw rule updated.
Sam H.: perfect — thanks everyone. schedule updated to reflect 3-node guardrail.
